framing: He Was Socrates is not 'an AI bust' — it is a deterministic on-device speech engine with a fixed Korean Socratic prompt. Strip every AI-marketing tell from the surface and present the product as a traditional, predictable desktop tool with documented states and rule-based controls.
target_persona: Kaggle/DeepMind judges who are fatigued by 'AI-powered' chrome and a school district IT evaluator who wants software that behaves like Mail.app — clear states, named buttons, no surprises, no hallucinated copy, no animated 'thinking' shimmer to interpret.
primary_surface: Traditional SaaS desktop UI: header with product name + version, single primary [Listen] button bound to Spacebar, deterministic status pill (Idle / Listening / Composing / Speaking), rule-based 'Past wonderings' list with date-sorted browsing (no semantic AI search), Settings cog, and a locked-locale footer (ko-KR / en-US). The word 'AI' appears nowhere in the chrome; the model is referred to only as 'engine' or 'the bust'. Footer credits Gemma 4 honestly as engine, not surface.
opus_4_7_capability: Opus 4.7's strict instruction-adherence is used to enforce a vocabulary blocklist (no 'AI', 'thinking', 'magic', 'smart', 'powered by AI', 'assistant') across every visible string while preserving technical accuracy of the engine credit, and to keep deterministic state names consistent with EngineCoordinator.Phase (with one principled rename: thinking → Composing).
mvp_scope: A single static HTML mockup of the desktop app's main window — header, [Listen] primary button, deterministic status pill, Past wonderings side panel (3 sample entries, Korean 평어체 verbatim, sortable by date), Settings cog opening a locked-locale row, and the engine-credit footer. No motion, no gradient, no AI-flavored language. Demonstrates that the surface can be rule-based and traditional while the underlying engine remains Gemma 4 E4B 4-bit MLX.
one_liner_pitch: A desktop bust with the chrome of Mail.app — named buttons, named states, named locales — and zero AI-marketing language anywhere on the surface.
spec_alignment_notes: target_persona narrows spec.target_persona.primary (Kaggle/DeepMind judges) + adds the cost-conscious IT evaluator from spec.target_persona.secondary; primary_surface honors spec invariants (NO-CLOUD, defer_to_human, 평어체 verbatim, 1-bit halftone permitted but optional here since the persona prefers traditional SaaS chrome) and reframes the deliverable from 'Kaggle preview scroll page' to 'desktop-app screenshot' because the persona's anti-AI bias requires a product-UI artifact, not a marketing scroll — this is a legitimate within-spec reframing because the spec describes the bust app itself and the preview is allowed to depict it. EngineCoordinator.Phase 'thinking' is renamed to 'Composing' on the surface (engineering enum unchanged) per the persona rule that 'thinking' reads as AI-anthropomorphism; this is a surface-only relabel and does not violate the stable public API surface invariant. All 7 differentiators preserved as honest engine-credit footer + status semantics; Korean limited to bust subtitle and past-wondering log entries per spec.language_policy.
